title: Seven resources to make a vibe-coded landing page look good: 21st.dev, getdesign.md, WebGPU, impeccable.style, a site-recreation repo, awesome-design.md, and a 'Taste Skill' repo

tools.name: 21st.dev
tools.detail: 'The living library of interfaces' — high-quality UI components/assets

tools.name: getdesign.md
tools.detail: 'Steal any famous design system' — DESIGN.md files for known brands

tools.name: WebGPU
tools.detail: For web animations; screen shows a gallery of shader/GPU demos

tools.name: impeccable.style
tools.detail: 'The missing design vocabulary for agents' — design prompting/skill

tools.name: Landing-page recreation GitHub repo
tools.detail: Name not shown; demo shows a 'Ramp HQ' dashboard screenshot being recreated

claims: These seven tools make vibe-coded landing pages 'actually look good'
getdesign.md lets you 'steal any famous design system'
how_to_steps: 2. Grab a famous brand's design system as a DESIGN.md from getdesign.md
4. Use impeccable.style design prompting with your agent
5. Recreate a reference landing page with the (unnamed) GitHub repo
6. Use awesome-design to break down any brand's design blocks
7. Install the Taste Skill repo so Claude produces less slop
on_screen_only: 21st.dev homepage: 'The living library of interfaces' with 'Get inspired with us' hero
getdesign.md: long table of brand/design-system entries (names unreadable)
WebGPU: grid of ~30 shader demo thumbnails
impeccable.style hero: 'The missing design vocabulary for agents' with a chat example 'Ship the launch plan by Friday'
Repo demo screenshot of a 'Ramp HQ' finance dashboard
GitHub page: 'Taste Skill — The Anti-Slop Frontend Framework for AI Agents' with example cards 'Built ... AI agency presence' and 'Less slop, design pop'

relevance.why: Founder ships landing pages and app UIs with Claude Code; design slop is the visible weakness of vibe-coded products. impeccable.style, Taste Skill and DESIGN.md files are skill-style inputs that drop straight into a Claude Code project.

implement_score.why: Install impeccable + Taste Skill and pick one DESIGN.md as the house style: an afternoon, reusable across every app. WebGPU and 21st.dev are nice-to-have. Unnamed repos need identifying first.

verify: Identify the two unnamed GitHub repos (#5 landing-page recreation, #7 Taste Skill) and check stars/maintenance
Licensing of components from 21st.dev and of copied brand design systems
